ينتصبون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَصِبُونَ (yantaṣibūna) /jan.ta.sˤi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# يُنْتَصَبُونَ (yuntaṣabūna) /jun.ta.sˤa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
